|sellprice = 100 |quality = false }} The '''Snake Vertebrae''' can be obtained by digging up [[Artifact Spot|Artifact Spots]] on [[Ginger Island#Island West|Ginger Island West]] (22.5% chance), mining [[Mining#Mussel Node|Mussel Nodes]] on the Ginger Island [[Ginger Island#The Beach|beach]] (2.5% chance), or breaking other rocks on Ginger Island West (1% chance). ==Donation== Two Snake Vertebrae can be donated to the [[Island Field Office]] as part of the [[Island Field Office#Snake|Snake]] specimen, for which the reward is 3 [[Golden Walnut]]s and a [[Mango Sapling]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |hate=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus,Leo }} ==Bone Mill== The Snake Vertebrae can be turned into [[Quality Fertilizer]], [[Speed-Gro]], [[Deluxe Speed-Gro]] or [[Tree Fertilizer]] in the [[Bone Mill]]. ==Tailoring== Snake Vertebrae can be used in the spool of a [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Skeleton Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt014.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a yellow dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Quests== *[[Quests#Fragments of the past|"Fragments of the past"]]: [[Gunther]] may make a request on the [[Quests#List of Special Orders|Special Orders board]] for 100 of any combination of bone items that must be gathered while the quest is active. You have 7 days to complete the quest. The reward is {{Price|3500}} and the [[Bone Mill]] recipe. ==Bugs== *The game code stipulates a 1% chance of obtaining a Snake Vertebrae by killing a Tiger Slime in the [[Ginger Island#Tiger Slime Grove|Tiger Slime Grove]]. However, the Snake Vertebraes spawn far outside of the map boundaries and thus cannot be collected. ==References== See IslandWest::breakStone in the game code. See IslandWest::monsterDrop and Game1::createObjectDebris in the game code. ==History== {{History|1.5|Introduced.}} {{History|1.6|Can now be found by mining [[Mining#Mining Nodes|Mussel Nodes]] and breaking stones on Ginger Island West.}} [[Category:Field Office donations]] [[Category:Bugs tested in 1.6]] [[de:Schlangenwirbel]] [[es:Vértebra de serpiente]] [[fr:Vertèbres de serpent]] [[it:Vertebre di serpente]] [[ja:ヘビの背骨]] [[ko:뱀 척추]] [[hu:Kígyó csigolya]] [[pt:Vértebra de Cobra]] [[ru:Змеиный позвоночник]] [[tr:Yılan Omuru]] [[zh:蛇脊椎骨]]
